visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black button-up shirt, sits in front of a yellow shelf filled with LEGO sets (a castle and the Statue of Liberty). He looks at the camera with an expressive face, gesturing with his hands. (2) A digital map graphic of Taisi Township in Yunlin, Taiwan appears, outlined in red dashed lines. The background shifts to a simplified blue and white interface. (3) A close-up of a woman wearing a light beige hijab and a matching garment. She has deep-set eyes and looks off-camera with a neutral expression against a plain wall. (4) A satellite map of Jinjiang City, Fujian Province, China is displayed. A red location pin marks a specific spot on the terrain. (5) Footage of a harbor with multiple large green and red cargo ships on a calm sea under a bright, clear sky. (6) A group of people on camels travels across a golden sand desert during sunset. The camera pans slowly across the horizon. (7) A stylized world map focusing on the Middle East and Asia shows red lines connecting coastal regions. (8) A woman in a white hijab and white clothing is seen sitting on the floor in a prayer pose, with a small table nearby holding dates and a glass of water. (9) The man returns to center-screen, talking energetically with wide hand motions. A promotional graphic for a course titled 'East Asian History Exploration' slides into the frame at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 歷史老師真的問什麼都答得出來嗎. [Logo]: @taiwanbar. (2) [Subtitle]: 聽說臺灣有上萬個阿拉丁欸. (3) [Subtitle]: 就是有一群阿拉伯的後裔住在雲林台西. (4) [Subtitle]: 而且都姓丁. [Variety]: 可以這樣簡稱的喔？ (5) [Subtitle]: 這群人其實是近年才發現原來有這個淵源. (6) [Subtitle]: 最早就發現台西這些丁姓的人五官的輪廓都很深邃. (7) [Subtitle]: 看起來好像外國人. (8) [Subtitle]: 就有些地方的文史工作者開始去溯源. (9) [Subtitle]: 發現最早他們是從福建晉江縣來的. (10) [Subtitle]: 發現他們的祖先原來是阿拉伯人. (11) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼福建會有阿拉伯人？ (12) [Subtitle]: 跟東亞海域上早期的海上絲路的貿易有關. (13) [Subtitle]: 但可能大家一開始想到的絲路是穿越沙漠跟陸路的絲路. (14) [Subtitle]: 但其實還有一條海上絲路. (15) [Subtitle]: 海上絲路就可以從中國的沿海連接到印度阿拉伯半島. (16) [Subtitle]: 很多阿拉伯商人就這樣順著這條海上絲路來到中國做生意. (17) [Subtitle]: 也就這樣定居下來. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後在清代乾隆年間又輾轉的來到了雲林台西. (19) [Subtitle]: 那這些阿拉丁還保有阿拉伯文化嗎？ (20) [Subtitle]: 不能說完全沒有但一定少到他們自己都不知道. (21) [Subtitle]: 反而是到了近代由於他們認祖的重新發現. (22) [Subtitle]: 有一些穆斯林的活動在當地舉辦. (23) [Subtitle]: 也是一種文化再造. (24) [Slogan]: 上一堂東亞史探索課.
